scope: Wire the run-engine decided-history emission into the NFL daily master_pipeline (Phase 3b) so the Totals & Run Lines dashboard stays current without manual backfills. MLB mirror: one dated markets file per run carrying decided OOF rows WITH actuals + today's slate rows; history accumulates via committed dated files. Phase A (33145c1) built the deterministic backfill core and shared board path; this change wires them into the daily run. FEATURE_COLUMNS / served 12-pool / MLB + frontend untouched.

pipeline_phases: Phase 0 environment -> Phase 1 ingest (decided frame) -> Phase 2 features -> Phase 3 moneyline ensemble + gated slate

Phase 3b run-engine markets emission (NEW): runs at the END of phase3 (after the moneyline ensemble, before Phase 4 sync) — MLB mirror: pipeline.py runs run_engine_daily at the end of its moneyline/training phase, regenerating the dated markets artifact every run
Phase 4 GitHub sync: content-diff staging of nfl-backend/data_delivery (only files changed vs the committed copy), explicit force-add so a brand-new gitignored dated .csv is committed
Phase 5 stale-artifact cleanup: only stale UNTRACKED files swept; tracked/committed never deleted
wiring_map.call_graph: master_pipeline.phase3 -> master_pipeline._phase3b -> run_nfl_markets_backfill.run_daily_markets (the SAME shared core the standalone backfill CLI main() calls — one schema, no fork). The core reuses run_nfl_slate.build_board_inputs / price_board_rows (the shared board path from 33145c1) and run_nfl_era's own E2 entrypoints (regenerate_era_e2 / _folds_for / _sealed_era_eval) with the pinned chain: era E2 ewm_2w rounds 20/23, DN joint sigma 9.663/9.0789 rho 0.0076 tie 0.275%, totals (c,d) = (-0.3599, 0.3472), spread (c,d) = (0.446165, 0.307486).
emitted_file_set: nfl_run_engine_markets_{run_date}.csv         kind == oof (decided store WITH actuals) + kind == slate (today's board) in one file, 250-col schema
nfl_run_engine_markets_{run_date}.meta.json   treatment mode, line-vintage status, decided-store calibration + regeneration checks
nfl_run_engine_monitor_{run_date}.json        research-pinned OOF baseline + backfill-computed calibration + accumulating slate-history (empty until served 2026 slate rows decide)
nfl_slate_serve_{run_date}.json               run gates + mapping table (the record)
wiring_map.standalone_entrypoint: run_nfl_markets_backfill.py remains the standalone/backfill CLI (thin wrapper over the same run_daily_markets core); --out-dir added for dry/scratch emissions.

idempotency: Same-date re-runs reproduce the store byte-identically: no RNG, no re-fit drift, and each dated file is regenerated from scratch — never appended to — so no duplicate rows are possible. Record-pin verification (g3) and a double-pricing-walk gate (g2) run before every emission. Meta/monitor as-of timestamps advance per run by design (as-of semantics).

board_backed_records: nfl_predictions_history_* — kept while the filename date still renders a board
retention_rules.tracked_never_deleted: ANY file committed to git is the permanent record; the sweep never deletes it (2026-09-01 regression guard) — dated history accumulates, growth is expected and matches MLB (judgment call 1)
retention_rules.same_day_retention: today + previous GMT day kept regardless
retention_rules.sweep_scope: only stale UNTRACKED files outside protection/retention/board windows are removed
retention_rules.no_day_window_truncation: none — no window ever truncates old dated markets/monitor history

degradation_policy: The shared core RAISES (prints the FATAL reason) on ANY frame-sha / record-pin / gate breach; _phase3b lets the exception propagate — the run stops loudly before sync/cleanup, nothing partial is emitted, and the last good committed dated store remains the served store until the degradation is resolved (judgment call 2). A dry path without nflreadpy (no board/slate possible) is the one graceful skip, mirroring Phase 3's slate stage.

judgment_calls.1_accumulating_history: the Monitor needs accumulating dated history — old dated files are never deleted; growth is expected and matches MLB
judgment_calls.2_loud_stop_over_silent_degrade: a daily run that cannot produce a verified store stops loudly rather than shipping a partial walk as fresh; re-runs of a same date are byte-identical
judgment_calls.3_force_add_gitignored_csv: the markets CSV is gitignored (nfl-backend/.gitignore data_delivery/*.csv); Phase 4's sync now calls repo.index.add(staged, force=True) (git add -f semantics — gitpython's add defaults to force, made explicit + behavior-pinned by test) so a brand-new dated .csv is committed every run and the frontend can fetch it from GitHub
